validation_rows.evidence_summary: [REVIVED] Layer-1 keyword hits on 'agentic-AI CVE class', 'agent CVE', 'LLM-integration CVE', 'CVE taxonomy', 'manifest loader' against the dormant entry's signal column. An eleventh agentic-AI tooling-stack CVE drops Friday-morning Pacific: Haystack CVE-2026-45013 (CVSS 8.5), a path-traversal in the pipeline-component manifest fetcher's nested-dependency resolver. Trail of Bits publishes a Friday extended addendum updating its taxonomy from ten to eleven agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader CVEs (adding the Haystack nested-dependency-resolver instance to CrewAI, Haystack prior, AutoGen manifest-fetcher, AutoGen workflow-state, Semantic Kernel, LangChain prior load-time, LangChain workflow-state-intermediate, LiteLLM, and Pydantic AI), reaffirming the four-tier-and-sub-tier common-mitigation pattern with a nested-dependency-resolution canonicalization extension. DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft co-publish a Friday joint v4 addendum (arxiv 2605.06712v4) extending the runtime-verifier paper with formal compositional safety proofs covering all eleven CVE-pattern instances. The CISA federal-civilian operational-directive incorporating the now-ten-CVE Trail of Bits taxonomy clears the Office of Management and Budget publication queue and is scheduled for publication early the following week per Friday wire reporting.
